text:
maya_support: Customer reports intermittent 500s from /v1/generate, says "no request id" in their app logs. Asking what exact artifacts we need to triage.

ingrid_eng: Ask them for any request headers they can capture (X-Request-ID, X-Session-Ref, X-RW-Trace) + full error body and the SDK version. Also request a minimal curl or HAR. :mag:

maya_support: They only have mobile logs (iOS) and a timestamp. No HAR.

mike_mobile: For iOS apps using our SDK, enable verbose logging and repro like this:
```swift
// turn on verbose logs
RWSDK.shared.logLevel = .debug
// reproduce the failing call
RWSDK.shared.generate(prompt: "...") { resp in ... }
```
Look for lines containing `session.ref` or `x-request-id` in SDK output. If using an older SDK, ask them to upgrade to v1.4+ first.

devx_ryan: For a quick repro from their server/proxy ask them to run:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Session-Ref: demo-abc123" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
That shows response headers (`-i`) including any `X-Request-ID` we return. Tell them to redact the auth key.

support-bot: Quick template you can paste to the customer: 
"Please provide: 1) exact timestamp (UTC) of the failure, 2) full request headers (redact token), 3) response body and headers (copy raw), 4) SDK name+version, 5) minimal curl or HAR, 6) SDK debug log snippet showing `session.ref`/`x-request-id`."

ingrid_eng: If they see 401 or 402, include the full JSON error body we return (it often contains the request id). For intermittent 5xx with NO trace id, likely an intermediate proxy is stripping headers.

sam_ops: If proxy stripping is suspected, ask for their edge/Nginx/ALB config. Example Nginx forward block: 
```nginx
proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
proxy_pass https://api.redwood.ai;
```
Alternatively check any header-wiping rules in their CDN.

mike_mobile: For Android, enable SDK debug: `Redwood.setLogLevel(REDBG.DEBUG)` and grep for `session.ref:` in `adb logcat`. For React Native, `console.debug` output includes `rw:session` lines.

maya_support: Good. I'll send the template + a short how-to for iOS/Android + the curl example. If customer can't produce a request-id but reproduces the error I'll escalate to runtime with the timestamp and full payload.

ingrid_eng: One more: ask them to capture server time drift and timezone; small clock skew can make it hard to match our logs. Also request the account id or org id (last 4) if it's a billing/auth issue.

support-bot: If they provide a HAR, we prefer exported HAR (not just screenshots). HAR -> we can extract headers + full request body + timing.

maya_support: Thanks all — sending now. Will post back with whatever they return. :thumbsup:
